title: Iraq & Mesopotamia Tracker Update — Tue Aug 25, 2026
summary: Iraq's PMF disarmament standoff sharpened through August. PM Zaidi declared September 30 the 'fixed and final' date for the US-led coalition withdrawal after meeting CENTCOM's Gen. Brad Cooper (Aug 12), while Badr publicly warned that forcing militias to disarm risks 'internal strife' (Aug 13-14) days after the Iran-aligned 'Islamic Resistance in Iraq' postponed retaliation against joint US-Saudi strikes following Badr mediation (Aug 7). Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf made a high-profile Baghdad visit (Aug 19-21) as Iraq sought Hormuz transit relief with oil revenue collapsed from $6.8B in February to $2.3B in June. By August 23, parliament's Security and Defense Committee finalized a draft PMF Authority Law that would make the PMF a permanent, multi-billion-dollar state institution — a move analysts warn undercuts the disarmament push. Iraq and Turkey separately signed a one-year Kirkuk-Ceyhan pipeline transit deal (Aug 1) to partially offset export losses.

title: Iraq & Mesopotamia Update — May 24, 2026
summary: Ali al-Zaidi was sworn in as Iraq's youngest PM (age 40) on May 16 after parliament approved a partial 14-minister cabinet on May 14; nine key portfolios including defense and interior remain vacant pending post-Eid negotiations. The KRG signed $110 billion in US gas contracts on May 19, triggering Baghdad's suspension of Kurdistan's May budget transfer and leaving 1.2 million Kurdish civil servants facing a salary crisis. A US-charged Kata'ib Hezbollah commander faces terrorism charges over a New York synagogue bomb plot; KH issued threats toward Jordan over alleged reconnaissance overflights. Iraq's oil output remains ~1.5 million bpd — 66% below pre-Hormuz crisis levels — with full recovery not expected until late 2026 per analyst consensus.

title: Iraq & Mesopotamia Update — May 9, 2026
summary: Ali al-Zaidi (39), a Dhi Qar businessman, was named prime minister-designate on April 27 by the Coordination Framework with US endorsement, advancing a 14-pillar governance program; KRG President Nechirvan Barzani traveled to Baghdad on May 4 to press on salary arrears and Article 140. US Treasury sanctioned Iraq's Deputy Oil Minister and PMF leaders on May 7 for facilitating Iranian sanctions evasion through oil-mixing. The Iraqi Air Force killed three ISIS militants in Kirkuk Province airstrikes on May 7 amid the group's ongoing post-caliphate insurgency.
